# Elevate Website Designs

> Web design, local SEO, website maintenance and Google Business Profile
> optimisation for small businesses across Torquay, Geelong and the Surf
> Coast in Victoria, Australia. Sole operator, custom-coded websites,
> fixed pricing.

Elevate Website Designs is run by Lachlan Mooney and is based in Torquay,
Victoria 3228. It serves Torquay, Jan Juc, Geelong, Armstrong Creek,
Barwon Heads, Ocean Grove, Anglesea, Aireys Inlet, Lorne and Winchelsea.

Websites are hand-coded rather than built on page builders or templates,
which keeps them fast and reduces the security surface. Typical builds
run one to three weeks and are quoted as a fixed price in writing before
work starts. Clients own their site, domain and hosting outright.

## Services

- [Website Design & Build](https://elevatewebsites.co.site/services/web-design): Custom-coded, mobile-first websites. Copywriting, hosting setup and technical SEO foundations included.
- [Local SEO](https://elevatewebsites.co.site/services/local-seo): On-page optimisation, local citations, Google Business Profile work and monthly reporting from Google Search Console data.
- [Website Maintenance](https://elevatewebsites.co.site/services/website-maintenance): Security patching, off-site backups, uptime monitoring, broken link checks and content updates. Month to month, no lock-in.
- [Google Business Profile Optimisation](https://elevatewebsites.co.site/services/google-business-profile): Profile claiming, categorisation, review strategy and ongoing management to compete in the local map pack.

## Areas served

- [Web Design Torquay](https://elevatewebsites.co.site/web-design-torquay): Home base. In-person meetings available.
- [Web Design Geelong](https://elevatewebsites.co.site/web-design-geelong): Larger, more competitive market with higher search volume.
- [Web Design Surf Coast](https://elevatewebsites.co.site/web-design-surf-coast): Jan Juc, Anglesea, Aireys Inlet, Lorne, Winchelsea and surrounds.
